product_metadata.title: Copco 5224644 9" Turntable Lazy Susan, 9-Inch, White/Blue
features: Create more space in cluttered cabinets with this very functional organizer
Each shelf is 2 3/4-inch deep, perfect for organizing spices, Soup or vegetable cans, sauces and more
Use outside the kitchen to organize cosmetics, perfume, skincare products, figurines, and office supplies; the possibilities are endless
Made from durable, long-lasting plastic with non-slip shelf lining

Measures 3-1/2-inch high by 8-3/4-inch deep by 15-inch wide; wipe with a damp cloth when needed.Organize everything-perfect for organizing your kitchen, your refrigerator, your craft or hobby room or even your bathroom cabinets
description: The Copco 9-inch Turntable is a perfect storage solution for your home. Use on countertops, under the sink, in your laundry room, pantry, garage, and more to make your living spaces neat and tidy. This smooth-glide, revolving organizer provides easy access to everything you need. Its nonskid liner keeps items in place while rotating, and its raised, 3/8-inch rim prevents items from falling off when in use. Measures 9 inches in diameter. To clean, wipe with a damp cloth.
